title: 第5章 这才是有钱人的快乐第6章 是买东西快乐还是
slug: 我都无敌了要你这系统有何用
content_zh:
青墨被掌柜请到楼上，刚刚进入会客厅，只见她凤眼含春，长眉入鬓，嘴角含着笑意，约莫二十二三岁年纪，甚是美貌。
“云想衣裳花想容，春风拂槛露华浓”
青墨还是头一次看到那么漂亮的女人，比自己还在享受996那家公司的经理强多了！
女子捂嘴轻笑，眼中闪烁着光芒。
“公子好文采，敢问公子贵姓？”
“青墨”
“小女子姓柳名雨柔”
“公子拿来的两颗大药，我们听雨阁愿意每颗出一亿上品灵石收购，落星石也愿意奉送给公子，不知公子意下如何？”
“有话直说就行，我不喜欢欠别人什么”
“那小女子就直说了，公子当日手段震惊南疆，我们听雨阁想请公子当听雨阁做名誉长老，可行副阁主的权利，不知公子意下如何？”
“这点小事，本公子没兴趣，唯一让我感兴趣的只有你个人手中的，紫纹竹！”
柳雨柔瞳孔瞬间缩小，“怎么可能他怎么可能知道我有紫纹竹？我从来没有和任何人说过，和我一起偷偷进入秘境的人都死光了才对啊”
“他既然准确的说出来在我手中肯定志在必得，凭他的手段我哪怕底牌尽出能逃走的可能性也极低”
“公子说什么紫纹竹？小女子从来没听说过啊？”
“柳雨柔，或者本公子应该叫你寒雨女帝？”
这句话说出口，柳雨柔心脏都按时停止一下，知道装傻充愣也没用了。
“你到底是谁？为什么本帝的印象里从来没见过你，你是怎么识破本帝的？”
“宿主，你怎么突然把她的真实身份说出来了？”
“说了就说了有什么大不了的，不说出来难道你想听她装傻充愣？”
青墨无所谓的对系统说到

“你不用管本公子怎么知道的，本公子只对紫纹竹感兴趣，你老老实实交出来就行了”
“不可能，本帝哪怕把它毁了也不会给你，本帝知道你能随意使用空间法则，哪怕本帝重生前都做不到像你这般轻松”
在柳雨柔想毁掉紫纹竹的瞬间直接被青墨封印全部修为，连灵魂重生时带的那点仙力一起封印。
“哪怕是你前世巅峰都不可能在本公子面前搞任何小动作，更何况现在？”
“死前能不能让我问最后一个问题？你到底是什么境界？”
“本公子没想杀你”
“系统有没有什么东西能让她恢复前世一半实力？小世界的东西太高级了，她也用不了”
“宿主你想收了她？”
“加过班，吃过苦，我还不能享受享受啦？”
“有倒是有不过干嘛回复一半啊？”
“她现在的实力太拉跨了，在此方世界不算垫底也差不多了，而且你不觉得有那么漂亮的女帝做打手，有种吃软饭的感觉吗？”

不退不换，童叟无欺。”
“不是说好了一折吗？就这两破烂还要八百万特等灵石？统子，你黑啊”
“黑什么黑，你缺这点散碎？”
“买了”

content_en:
Qing Mo was invited upstairs by the shopkeeper. As soon as she entered the living room, she saw her rosy eyes, long eyebrows, and a smile on her lips. She was about twenty-two or three years old, and she was very beautiful.
"The clouds think of clothes, the flowers think of face, the spring breeze blows the threshold and the dew is strong."
This was the first time Qing Mo saw such a beautiful woman, much better than the manager of the company he was still enjoying in 996!
The woman covered her mouth and chuckled, her eyes twinkling.
"Young Master is very talented in literature. May I ask your surname?"
"Green Ink"
"The little girl's surname is Liu and her name is Yurou"
"We Tingyuge are willing to pay 100 million high-grade spiritual stones for each of the two big medicines that the young master brought. We are also willing to give the falling star stone to the young master. I wonder what the young master wants?"
"Just say what you want. I don't like to owe others anything."
"The little lady will tell you frankly. The young master's actions that day shocked Southern Xinjiang. We Tingyuge want to ask the young master to be the honorary elder of Tingyu Pavilion. He can have the rights of deputy master. I wonder what the young master wants?"
"I am not interested in this trivial matter. The only thing that interests me is the purple-patterned bamboo in your own hands!"
Liu Yurou's pupils shrank instantly, "How could he possibly know that I have purple-patterned bamboo? I have never told anyone that all the people who secretly entered the secret realm with me should die."
"Since he told me accurately, he must be determined to win in my hands. With his methods, the possibility of me escaping even if I use all my cards is extremely low."
"Master, what do you mean by purple patterned bamboo? My little girl has never heard of it?"
"Liu Yurou, or should I call you Empress Hanyu?"
Liu Yurou's heart stopped when she said these words, knowing that there was no point in pretending to be dumbfounded.
"Who are you? Why have I never seen you in my memory? How did you find out about me?"
"Host, why did you suddenly reveal her true identity?"
"What's the big deal if you say it? If you don't say it, do you want her to pretend to be stupid?"
Qing Mo said to the system indifferently
"You don't have to worry about how I know this. I'm only interested in purple-patterned bamboo. Just hand it over honestly."
"It's impossible. Even if I destroy it, I won't give it to you. I know that you can use the laws of space at will. Even before I was reborn, I couldn't do it as easily as you."
The moment Liu Yurou wanted to destroy the purple patterned bamboo, all her cultivation was sealed by Qingmo, including the bit of immortal power that her soul brought when it was reborn.
"Even if you were at the peak of your previous life, it would be impossible for you to do anything small in front of me, let alone now?"
"Can I ask you one last question before you die? What state are you in?"
"I don't want to kill you"
"Is there anything in the system that can restore her to half of her previous life's strength? The stuff in the small world is too advanced for her to use."
"Host, do you want to take her in?"
"I've worked overtime and endured hardships, but I still can't enjoy myself?"
"Yes, yes, but why are you replying half of it?"
"Her current strength is too great. She is not even at the bottom in this world. And don't you think it feels like having such a beautiful empress as a thug?"

"Liuyuan Immortal Spring and Yunshen Pill, a total of eight million special spiritual stones.
No refund or exchange, no child or old man can be deceived. "
"Didn't we agree on a 10% discount? Just these two pieces of junk and you want eight million special spiritual stones? Tongzi, you are stupid."
"Why is it so black? What do you lack?"
"Bought"
Qing Mo temporarily forgot that he was a rich man. After all, he had been really poor for almost twenty years.
"Hey, I'll give you a chance. From now on, you can be my maid. You can help me squeeze my shoulders, beat my legs, and make the bed. How about I help you get revenge?"
"Oh, men always have this kind of virtue.
